name: anskills
description: A curated marketplace of Claude Code skill plugins. Clone the repo, add it as a marketplace, and install any skill from it.

plugins.name: business-plan-research
plugins.description: Conduct unbiased, citation-backed market research for a business idea and produce a structured business plan as a Google Doc. Spawns parallel research agents, synthesizes findings with inline citations, generates charts via quickchart.io, and uploads the final report as a Google Doc.
